data.body: **[P1] Complete operations created after suspension.** If the root handler starts an operation after `signalSuspension()` has already called `stopAllOperations`, this branch throws on the worker but the wrapper swallows `SuspendExecutionException`, leaving the newly registered operation’s completion future unresolved. A synchronous `step()`/child-context call then blocks indefinitely, as exercised by `laterStepMustUnwindAfterTokenWithdrawal`. Reject registration using the stored suspension cause or complete this operation exceptionally before throwing.
